body.objective: Proof-first nonlinear cutover: classify whether the Einstein-image/additional-Weyl exact sequence admits an admissible equivariant filtered splitting compatible with the retained cyclic L-infinity operations, or identify the invariant obstruction and minimal noncontractible or mixed-bundle enlargement required.
body.stop_condition: Define the exact sequence, category of admissible filtered/mixed-bundle maps, residual action, cyclic pairing, and equivalence under filtered L-infinity redefinitions. Prove a splitting/extension theorem or land the first invariant obstruction class with a complete bounded minimal-enlargement classification. Only after that theorem fixes the search space may a consumer-gated Conflux run import q2/q3/ell2/ell3 and propose candidate crosswalks. Every surviving candidate must be independently substituted into the original chain, cyclicity, and retained-ell3 verifiers. The mode-pair source table is a later ticket.
body.current_gate: equivariant cyclic extension/splitting theorem before branch-mixing search
body.forbid: no row-name branch identification; no revival of the obstructed same-bundle support-local projector; no hard-coded desired crosswalk; no Conflux before typed preflight and known-obstruction rediscovery; no candidate promoted without original-verifier substitution; no per-mode source, harmonic selection, physical sign, ghost, scattering, or all-orders claim
activates: an admissible branch crosswalk or a minimal mixed-bundle enlargement theorem
then one bounded mode-pair source-table ticket
body.resource_hint: FIRST AUTHORITATIVE NONLINEAR PROOF-FIRST CASE. Begin with the extension category and obstruction class, not the 150k-term payload. Conflux is optional only after the resident nonlinear preflight from sf:forge-request/conflux-resident-physics-discovery-pilots lands and independently rediscovers the known same-bundle obstruction.
notes: Mathematical target: the cyclic filtered L-infinity extension carried by 0 -> E_Einstein -> E_Weyl -> E_extra -> 0, including the residual action and retained pairing.

Candidate theorem: either an admissible equivariant filtered splitting exists in a declared mixed-bundle category, or the retained ell3 defines a nontrivial cyclic deformation/extension class whose minimal representative forces a specified noncontractible or enlarged carrier.

Proof obligations: define admissible morphisms and redefinitions; separate splitting dependence from invariant operations; identify the relevant cyclic deformation complex; locate the known subprincipal projector obstruction in it; prove completeness of the bounded enlargement family.

Counterexample strategy: the known same-bundle support-local projector mutation must fail; grading/sign mutations must be rejected; any proposed split must satisfy the original chain, residual-equivariance, cyclicity, and retained-ell3 identities by direct substitution.

Certificate boundary: this ticket establishes a structural crosswalk or obstruction only. It does not establish a mode-pair source table, harmonic selection rules, physical signs, ghost removal, scattering, or all-order nonlinear closure.
